changelog.why: Row 14 of the lexicon pipeline - the anagram ladder is now three rungs (category, first ezhuthu, meaning) and this allowance is what caps how many a day may bake. Left at 2 the dearest rung, the one that says what the word means, would never reach a puzzle. It is a ceiling rather than a promise: a rung a word cannot honestly answer is skipped, so most days still bake two.
